description.value:
Your small stature does less to limit your strength and toughness than it does for others of your kind. Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Your speed increases by 5 feet. You lose the Pintsized trait, and the Puny trait's cap of +3 to attack and damage bonuses on Strength-based weapon attacks no longer applies to you.

You gain the Undersized trait: your small frame makes larger weapons awkward to wield. You can't use heavy shields or two-handed martial weapons unless they also have the light property, and any versatile martial weapon you wield must be used in two hands.
